items.text:
I lead a commercial sales org at ClickUp, and Brain² has become the teammate I didn't know I needed. 

Here's how my team uses it daily:

🔮 Forecast prep in seconds. Brain² pulls deal context, pipeline movement, and risk signals across our entire workspace. What used to take 30 min of tab-hopping before a forecast call now takes one prompt.

📝 Meeting follow-ups that write themselves. AI Notetaker captures the call, Brain² drafts the recap and next steps, and posts it right in our deal channels. No one's scrambling to remember what was said.

💬 Instant answers from tribal knowledge. New reps used to Slack five people to find a talk track or policy doc. Now they ask Brain² and get the answer with the source linked, in seconds.

📊 Weekly updates without the Sunday scaries. I generate my leadership update from actual task and pipeline data, not from memory. It's more accurate and takes 2 minutes.

The difference between Brain² and every other AI tool I've tried? It actually knows our deals, our process, our people. It's not a generic chatbot; it's contextualized to how we work.

#ClickUp #Brain2 #SalesLeadership #AI #Revenue
